meta.parties: Ramalingam Chettiar v. Mohamed Adjwad Et Al

rules.statement: Heirs are only liable for the extent of property that has passed into their hands after administration is completed by executors.
rules.supporting_quote: "The liability of the heirs depends upon proof that administration has been completed by the executors and that property belonging to the estate has passed into their hands and is limited to the extent of such property."
